free_instructions.numeric_scalar: Answer with only one exact number. A fraction or decimal is allowed. Do not include units or an explanation.
free_instructions.unordered_numeric_multiset: Answer with only the requested numbers, separated by commas. Preserve repeated values when multiplicity is requested. Do not explain.
free_instructions.ordered_numeric_tuple: Answer with only the ordered pair (x,y). Do not explain.
free_instructions.symbolic_alias: Answer with only the exact mathematical expression. Use pi for pi and C for an integration constant. Do not explain.
free_instructions.text_label: Answer with only the mathematical term. Do not explain.

mcq_instruction: Answer with exactly one letter: A, B, C or D. Do not explain.
mcq_rotation: left cyclic rotation; new gold index = (old index - rotation) mod 4

metrics.free: correct/50 with incorrect, unparseable, empty and termination counts
metrics.mcq: correct/200 plus all-four-rotations-correct/50 and answer-letter histogram; 200 responses are not 200 independent questions

comparison_rule: Compare only runs with identical suite, protocol, prompt plan, scorer, mode and backend policy. Declare intentionally varied model artifacts. Repeat greedy runs are stability checks, not additional independent items.
symbolic_policy: Finite declared aliases; not general algebraic equivalence. No extraction of a last number from prose.
